name: mcp-server-apidebug
description: A standalone MCP server for API debugging, login authentication, API configuration management, and indexed API execution.

rawRecord.description: A standalone MCP server for API debugging, login authentication, API configuration management, and indexed API execution.

CONFIG_DIR.description: Optional config directory override; generally not needed. When not set, uses `PROJECT_PATH/.setting/{TOOL_PREFIX}`.

TOOL_PREFIX.description: Tool name prefix; default tools are `default_api_debug`, `default_api_config`, etc.

PROJECT_PATH.description: Project directory; uses current directory when not set.

API_DEBUG_BASE_URL.description: API base URL; when configured, no need to set `baseUrl` via `api_config`.

API_DEBUG_LOGIN_BODY.description: Login request body, supports JSON string or plain string.

API_DEBUG_LOGIN_USER_HEADER.description: Header name for user ID (extracted from login response).

rawRecord.name: mcp-server-apidebug
